integrity: The infinite period-two orbit and Q-linear iterate law are proved algebraically from the published stepsize recurrence. High-precision replay is supplementary and is not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact cycle is an existence construction on a one-dimensional strongly convex quadratic with a specially chosen pair of initial stepsizes; attraction or genericity is not claimed.
The result concerns the quadratic-kernel specialization of B-adaPGα in Remark 2.9 and does not establish an analogous exact cycle for general Bregman kernels.
Targeted database and full-text checks reduce but do not eliminate the possibility of an older equivalent observation under different notation.
title: Plastic-constant exact stepsize two-cycle for quadratic-kernel B-adaPGα
